docs.title: 10BASE-T1S Trigger
docs.text:
10BASE-T1S trigger supports frame events / error checks and Clause Trigger pattern match on Destination / Source Address, Ethertype / Length, and Data. The physical layer is a single-pair differential link.

TravelBus provides dedicated 10BASE-T1 channels; for LA, verify the Data wiring. See Settings for channel prefixes and Clause Trigger for clause flow.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
10BASE-T1S Trigger (LA) 10BASE-T1S Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

Because TravelBus includes special 10BASE-T1 channels, the trigger dialog adds an extra channel-source option.

  • Channel: Dedicated port (TravelBus) or LA Data channelLA port.
  • Preamble Count: Lower / upper preamble count. Default: lower 1, upper 6.
  • Reference Point Adjust: Logic-level decision reference (1st / 2nd position). Default: 20 / 60.
  • Simple Trigger: Start / End / Beacon / Commit, ESD (BRS / ERR / HB / OK / JAB), Preamble Error / SSD, Frame / CRC / Symbol Error. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Destination Address, Source Address, Ethertype / Length, and Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • Address / Ethertype / Data: Default all XXh (Data up to 8 bytes).
    • Data Type: Default index 0 (normal Data).
    • Offset: Checking Fixed Offset enables (Enable) the offset field. Default: cleared, offset 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • 10BASE-T1S — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: BiSS-C Trigger (Bidirectional Serial Synchronous interface)
docs.text:
BiSS-C trigger supports frame start / end, CRC errors, and Clause Trigger pattern match on CTS / IDS / CMD / IDL and Data. Channels are MA / SLO.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
BiSS-C Trigger
  • Channel: Assign MA / SLO (channel indices omitted).
  • Serial data length: SCD bit length (max 255). Default: 12.
  • Type of data: CDM / CDS. Default: CDM.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame / End of frame. Default: all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: CRC6 Error / CRC4 Error. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: After selecting Commands or Register Communication under CTS, enter IDS / CMD / IDL / Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • CTS / CMD / IDS / IDL: Default CTS / CMD = Don't care; IDS / IDL = XXh.
    • Data: Default each field XXh; Data Size Default 0.
    • Bypass: Checking Bypass enables (Enable) the offset. Default: cleared, offset 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • BiSS-C — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: CAN FD Trigger (Controller Area Network, CAN with Flexible Data-Rate)
docs.text:
CAN / CAN FD trigger supports frame types, error checks, and Clause Trigger ID / Data patterns. The physical layer is differential (CAN_H / CAN_L).

Wrong Data Rate or channel mode prevents triggers. TravelBus offers a dedicated CAN port. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
CAN Trigger (LA) CAN Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)
  • Channel: Dedicated CAN port (TravelBus B) or LA channelLA port.
  • Channel Input: CAN_H / CAN_L selection. Default: index 0.
  • Data Rate: Arbitration-phase rate. Default: 500K.
  • CAN FD: Enable CAN FD. When checked, FD Data Rate / Sample Point / ISO-CRC are field enabled (Enable). Default: cleared.
    • FD Data Rate: Default: 5M.
    • Sample Point: Default: 80.
    • ISO-CRC / Non ISO-CRC: Default: ISO-CRC.
  • Simple Trigger: Data / Remote / Error / Overload / Start / End / ACK Error / CRC Error. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Trigger On includes 11-bit ID, 29-bit ID, Data, ID+Data; enter a data pattern; XXh / XXXh = Don't care.
    • Trig Mode: Default 11-bit ID; ID Default XXXh; Data1–8 Default XXh; Any Offset Default checked (offset 0).

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • CAN 2.0B / CAN FD — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: DALI Trigger (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface)
docs.text:
Open DALI 2 protocol trigger from the toolbar. Use Simple Trigger frame events or Clause Trigger with type (102 / 103), command kind (short / group / broadcast / response / special), CMD groups, or custom Address / Data / Opcode bytes.

Data Rate Default: 1200. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
DALI Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Assign the DALI channel.
  • Data Rate: Default: 1200.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame / End of frame. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Type (102, 103), command kind, CMD, or custom Address / Data / Opcode bytes.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • DALI — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: DisplayPort AUX Trigger (DisplayPort Auxiliary Channel)
docs.text:
DP Aux trigger supports Master / Slave frame start / end, Timeout, and Clause Trigger pattern match on Request / Reply, Command, and Data.

TravelBus provides a dedicated DP Aux channel. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
DisplayPort AUX Trigger (LA) DisplayPort AUX Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

Because TravelBus includes a special DP Aux channel, the trigger dialog adds an extra channel-source option.

  • Channel: Dedicated port (TravelBus) or LA Aux channelLA port.
  • Data Rate: DP Aux rate (units as shown). Default: 1000.
  • Simple Trigger: Master Start / End, Slave Start / End, Check Timeout. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Choose Request / Reply and set Command or Custom Data; enter values as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • Tx / Rx (Request / Reply): Default index 0 (Request).
    • Command: Default index 0. Custom enables (Enable) the Data fields.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • DisplayPort AUX — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: eSPI Trigger (Enhanced Serial Peripheral Interface)
docs.text:
eSPI trigger supports Format / Opcode / Response / Status / CRC errors and Clause Trigger pattern match on Command / Response and Data.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
eSPI Trigger
  • Channel: Assign CS / CLK / IO / Alert (channel indices omitted).
  • Start up settings: Default I/O, Alert, and CRC behavior at start-up.
    • IO Mode: Single / Dual / Quad. Default: Single Mode.
    • Alert Mode: Alert From I/O[1] / Alert Pin. Default: Alert From I/O[1].
    • CRC Mode: CRC Check Enable / Disable. Default: CRC Check Enable.
  • tCLQV: Output Valid time. Default: 15 ns.
  • Trigger on (Error): Opcode / Format / Response / CRC / Status Error. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Combine Opcode / Response fields and enter a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • Data Dir: Match Data in Command or Response. Default: Command side.
    • Opcode / Response: Default index 0.
    • Data Offset: With Any Offset checked, search the pattern inside the frame; if cleared, match from the frame start. Default: Any Offset checked, offset 0.
eSPI State: Data Dir / Data Offset

With Any Offset cleared, bytes are compared from the start of the frame (for example D0 = 13h matches only the first byte). With Any Offset checked, the consecutive byte pattern is searched in the frame (for example D0 = XXh, D1 = 11h triggers when the second byte is 11h).

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • eSPI — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: HID over I2C Trigger (Human Interface Device over I2C)
docs.text:
HID over I2C trigger supports I2C frame events (Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK) and Clause Trigger pattern match on address and HID Descriptor / Data. TravelBus may offer a dedicated I2C port.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
HID over I2C Trigger (LA) HID over I2C Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

Because TravelBus includes special I2C channels, the HID over I2C trigger dialog adds an extra channel-source option.

  • Channel: Dedicated I2C port (TravelBus B) or LA SCL / SDALA port.
  • Simple Trigger: Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Address, R/W, ACK, and Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care. You can also select an HID Descriptor; when Descriptor is selected, R/W switches to Read.
    • Address Mode: Default 7-bit; Address Default XXh; R/W and ACK Default Don't care.
    • Descriptor / Data: Default index 0 (XXh / normal Data).

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • HID over I2C — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: HyperBus Trigger
docs.text:
HyperBus trigger supports Start of frame and Clause Trigger pattern match on Command / Address and Data. Set bus width, Mode, and Latency to match the bus.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
HyperBus Trigger
  • Channel: Assign CS, CLK, RWDS1 / RWDS2, and Data (channel indices omitted).
    • Using CLK to latch Read Data: Latch read data with CLK. Related options are enabled (Enable) when checked.
    • DATA width: x8 / x16. Default: x16.
    • Quick set / User Defined: Batch-assign Data channels or set each bit manuallyUser Defined.
    • Settings: Data Arrangement format (popup).
    • Invert CLK / Invert RWDS: Invert CLK or RWDS1 / 2. Field enabled (Enable) when checked.
  • Mode: Hyper Flash / Hyper RAM. Default: Hyper Flash.
  • Latency: Latency sample-point count. Default: 7.
  • CMD / Write CLK Delay, Read CLK / RWDS Delay: Delay timing.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame. Field enabled (Enable) when checked.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Command / Address bits and Data as a data pattern; unused fields XX = Don't care.
    • Command / Data: Default each field XX.
    • Offset: Any Offset / Fixed Offset. Default: Any Offset, offset 0. Fixed Offset enables (Enable) the offset field.

docs.title: I2C Trigger (Inter-Integrated Circuit)
docs.text:
I2C trigger supports Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK, timing violations, clock stretching, and Clause Trigger pattern match on address and data.

TravelBus B series offers a dedicated I2C port; for LA channels, verify SCL / SDA. See Settings for channel prefixes and Clause Trigger for clause flow.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
I2C Trigger (LA) I2C Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)
  • Channel: Dedicated I2C port (TravelBus B) or LA channels. Default is the LA port.
  • Simple Trigger: Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK frame events. Default: all cleared.
  • Timing Violation: Trigger on timing checks in the popup. Default: all checks cleared (fields disabled).
  • Clock Stretching: Popup for stretching / timeout / violation. Field enabled (Enable) when the main option is checked. Default: cleared.
    • Clock stretching: Trigger when the slave stretches the clock. Default: cleared.
    • Timeout Check: Trigger after timeout. Default: cleared (timeout blank).
    • Violation Check: Illegal SCL width in HS mode. Default: cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: Combine conditions in the clause flow. See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Per-level conditions; enter Value / R/W / ACK / Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • Address Mode: 7-bit / 8-bit / 10-bit. Default: 7-bit.
    • Address / Data: Default address and Data1–4 = XXh; R/W and ACK = Don't care; equal (=) selected.
    • Data: Up to 4 bytes; unused = XXh. Click “=” to switch to “≠”.
    • Offset: Any Offset / Fixed Offset.
Timing Violation popup Clock Stretching popup

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • I2C — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: I2S Trigger (Inter-Integrated Circuit Sound)
docs.text:
I2S trigger supports data-pattern match, edge/glitch/Mute/Clip, or Timing Violation. Requires SCK/WS/SD.

Timing Violation is available only when the hardware sample rate is 200 MHz. See Settings.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
I2S Trigger
  • Channel: Select SCK, WS, and SD.
  • Data Bits: 1–32 bits (commonly 8/12/16/24/32). Default index is 0.
  • Method: Default index is 0 (Data Match). Related parameter fields are field enabled (Enable) or field disabled (Disable) by Method.
    • Data Match: Trigger when the audio data matches. Pattern A/B Default is 00h.
    • Rising Edge: Trigger when the later sample on the same channel is larger by more than the threshold.
    • Falling Edge: Trigger when the later sample is smaller by more than the threshold.
    • Glitch: Trigger on a short rise/fall spike beyond the threshold.
    • Mute: With threshold P, trigger when −P < X < +P.
    • Clip: With threshold P, trigger when −P < X ∪ +P > X.
    • Timing Violation: Six timing checks; enabled only at 200 MHz sample rate. Default: Setup 0, Hold 100, Period Min/Max 360/440, Duty Min/Max 160/160.
  • Data Trigger: Channel Default is Both; Compare Default index is 0; Duration Default is 1; Full-scale Voltage Default is 2000; Pattern unit Default is Value; Master/Slave Default is Master; Pass Count Default is 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • I2S — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: LIN Trigger (Local Interconnect Network)
docs.text:
LIN trigger supports frame events, checksum/error conditions, and Clause Trigger patterns on ID, Parity, Data Length, and Data (X / XXh = Don't care). LIN 2.2 can specify Data Length.

Wrong Data Rate or checksum mode may miss triggers. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
LIN Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Assign the LIN channel.
  • Data Rate: Default: 9600.
  • Checksum mode: Default: Classic.
  • Simple Trigger: Frame events (Start / End / Data / WakeUp / Sync, etc.). Default: all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: Checksum / Sync / Stop / Parity errors. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter ID, Parity, Data Length, Data, or leave X. LIN 2.2 can set Data Length.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • LIN — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: LPC Trigger (Low pin count)
docs.text:
LPC trigger supports START / CT/DIR / ADDR / Channel / Size / MSize / Sync errors and Clause Trigger pattern match on Cycle Type and related fields.

Mismatched Clock Edge versus the bus will not trigger. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
LPC Trigger
  • Channel: Assign LCLK, LFRAME#, LAD[0]–LAD[3]; optional AUX for extra status input. Field enabled (Enable) when AUX is checkedcleared.
  • Clock Edge: Falling Edge / Rising Edge (Clock latch on). Default: Rising Edge.
  • Error Trigger: START Error / CT/DIR Error / ADDR. Error (Bus Master) / Channel Error / Size Error / MSize Error / Sync Error. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Select Cycle Type and enter related fields as a data pattern, or leave X / Xh / XXXXb. Switch = / ≠ and optionally fix the Data packet offset.
    • Cycle Type: Default: Start of Frame.
    • Fixed Offset: Default: cleared; offset 0.

docs.title: MDIO Trigger (Management Data Input/Output)
docs.text:
MDIO trigger supports Start / Stop of frame, TA Error, and Clause Trigger pattern match on ST / OP / PHYADR / REGADR / DATA.

Preamble length and Clock Latch on must match the bus. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MDIO Trigger
  • Channel: Assign MDC / MDIO channels.
  • Clock Latch on: Rising Edge / Falling Edge. Default: Rising Edge.
  • Preamble: Preamble length (bits). Default: 32.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame / Stop of frame / TA Error. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter ST, OP, PHYADR, REGADR, DATA as a data pattern, or leave X / XXh / XXXXh. PHYADR(P) / REGADR(R) support range compare.
    • ST / OP: Default: both Any.
    • PHYADR / REGADR range: Default: =; value Default: XXh.
    • DATA: Default: XXXXh.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • MDIO — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: MII/RMII/RGMII/GMII Trigger (Media Independent Interface)
docs.text:
MII-family trigger supports frame start / end, errors, Collision, and Clause Trigger pattern match on Destination / Source Address, Ethertype, and Data.

BusFinder / LA support MII / RMII / RGMII / GMII; TravelLogic / MSO do not support GMII, and RGMII requires sample rate ≥ 1 GHz. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MII Trigger (BusFinder / LA) MII Trigger (TravelLogic / MSO)
  • Standard / type: MII / RMII / RGMII / GMII (by product). Default: MII.
  • Clk Latch: Latch on rising or falling CLK. Default index 0 (Rising / High active). Disabled (Disable) for RGMII.
  • RMII Clk: Enabled (Enable) only when type is RMII.
  • Channel: Assign TX / RX control and Data pins (channel indices omitted); Data Setting opens a popup for Data pins.
  • Phase Delay: In samples. Default: 0.
  • Simple Trigger: Start / End, Error Pin, Frame / CRC / Format Error, Carrier Extend (and Error), False Indication, Collision. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Destination / Source Address, Ethertype, and Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care. Choose TX or RX.
    • TX / RX: Default TX.
    • Address / Ethertype / Data: Default all XXh (Data up to 8 bytes).
    • Offset: Checking Fixed Offset enables (Enable) the offset. Default: cleared, offset 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • MII / RMII / RGMII / GMII — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: Mini/Micro LED Trigger
docs.text:
Mini / Micro LED trigger uses Clause Trigger pattern match on Command (DCLK edge count) and Data. Set DCLK Rate, magnification, and Latch to match the bus.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
Mini/Micro LED Trigger
  • Channel: Assign DCLK, LE, and Data (channel indices omitted).
  • DCLK Rate: DCLK rate (MHz). Default: 20.
  • Option (GCLK):
    • Magnification: Simulated CLK relative to DCLK (1 / 2 / 4 / 8). Default: 1.
    • Latch Data: Rising / Falling. Default: Rising. Disabled (Disable) when DDR mode is checked.
    • DDR mode: Dual-edge sampling. Checking enables (Enable) DDR behavior and disables Latch select. Default: cleared.
    • Delay: Delay in samples. Default: 0.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter DCLK edge count under Command; enter Data as a data pattern, unused XX.
    • Command: Checking enables (Enable) the field. Default: cleared; edge count Default 1.
    • Data: Checking enables (Enable) the fields. Default: checked; Size Default index 0 (8-bit width); each field Default XX; Shift Default 0 (cleared).

docs.title: MIPI I3C Trigger (Improved Inter-Integrated Circuit)
docs.text:
MIPI I3C trigger supports Start / Repeat Start / Stop, ACK / NACK, Error Trigger (TE0–TE5, CRC / Parity / Preamble), and Clause Trigger pattern match on Address / CCC / Data.

TravelBus provides special I2C channel options, so the MIPI I3C trigger UI on TravelBus includes an extra channel source. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MIPI I3C Trigger (LA) MIPI I3C Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)
  • Channel: I2C Port or LA Port. Default is LA port.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame / Repeat Start / Stop of frame. Default: all cleared.
  • ACK / NACK: Default: both cleared.
  • Error Trigger: SDR TE0–TE5; DDR CRC / Parity / Preamble. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Address / Common Command Code (CCC) / Data; enter a data pattern; XXh = Don't care.
    • Offset: Any Offset (Default; first matching I3C data) / Fixed Offset (byte position; offset 0 = first byte).
    • RSTDAA (06h) / ENTDAA (07h): Event 1 CCC = RSTDAA / ENTDAA; Event 2 with ENTDAA requires 9-bit data and Fixed Offset.
    • EHTHDR0 (20h) / EHTHDR1 (21h) / EHTHDR2 (22h) HDR Data: 16-bit payload format.
Trigger on RSTDAA / ENTDAA data (Event 1) ENTDAA 9-bit data (Fixed Offset) EHTHDR0 / 1 / 2 HDR Data (16-bit payload)

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• MIPI I3C — Protocol Analyzer settings
  • MIPI I3C — Measurement guide

docs.title: MIPI RFFE Trigger (MIPI RF Front-End Control Interface)
docs.text:
MIPI RFFE trigger supports Error Trigger (Start / End of frame, Bus Park Cycle, Parity / Frame Error) and Clause Trigger pattern match on Command type, Address, and Data.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MIPI RFFE Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Assign SCLK and SDATA.
  • Error Trigger: Start of frame / End of frame / Bus Park Cycle / Parity Error / Frame Error. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Per-level conditions; set Command type and enter Address / Data as a data pattern; XXh / X = Don't care.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • MIPI RFFE — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: MIPI SPMI Trigger (System Power Management Interface)
docs.text:
MIPI SPMI trigger supports Arbitration OFF, Trigger On, Error Trigger, Bus Timeout, and Clause Trigger pattern match on Device Address / Command / Data Address / Data.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MIPI SPMI Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Assign SCLK, SDATA, and Aux.
  • Arbitration OFF: Disables arbitration. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: cleared.
  • Trigger On: SSC / Bus Timeout / No Resp. Frame / Data Frame. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: CMD Frame Format / CMD Parity / Data Addr. Parity / Data Frame Parity / Bus Park / Non ACK / Arbitration Format. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Bus Timeout: Timeout length (display scaled by sample rate). Default slider ≈ 96 µs (source count 19200).
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Device Address, Command, Data Address, or Data as a data pattern; XXh / X = Don't care.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • MIPI SPMI — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: SD/eMMC Data Trigger
docs.text:
SD / eMMC Data trigger matches a Data Trigger Pattern after a selected Read / Write command, or fires on Timeout conditions.

Open from the toolbar “SD/eMMC Data protocol trigger”. See Settings.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
SD / eMMC Data Trigger Settings
  • Protocol Select: SD / eMMC. Default: SD.
  • Probe Select: Select the probe in use.
  • Data Settings: Bus width and mode. Default: 4-bit; DDR Mode cleared; Data Length 512.
  • tODLY Setting: Host-to-Device / Device-to-Host delay. Default: Host-to-Device 0; Device-to-Host 500 ps.
  • Data Trigger: When to start matching and the data pattern.
    • Start Data Trigger after READ command (CMD17/18): After CMD17 / 18, fire when the Data Trigger Pattern matches.
    • Start Data Trigger after WRITE command (CMD24/25): After CMD24 / 25, fire when the pattern matches.
    • Start Data Trigger after “CMD” as “READ” command: Treat the selected CMD as read / write, then match the pattern after that CMD.
  • Timeout Trigger: Checking Enable Timeout field-enables (Enable) the options. Default: Enable Timeout cleared; Data timeout after CMD/DATA selected among options; each timeout Default 5 ms; Busy Timeout CMD picks Default 17 / 18 / 24 / 25.
Timeout Trigger
  • Trigger on Data timeout after CMD/DATA: After Command or Data ends, Data stays idle past the limit. Default 5 ms (user-editable).
  • Trigger on Data IDLE timeout after CRC status: After Data ends, idle before CRC status exceeds the limit. Default 5 ms.
  • Trigger on Data IDLE timeout after CMD: After Command ends, idle before Data starts exceeds the limit. Default 5 ms.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• SDIO / SD 3.0 — Decode settings
  • eMMC — Protocol Analyzer settings
  • eMMC — Measurement guide

docs.title: MMC/eMMC Trigger (Embedded Multi Media Card)
docs.text:
MMC / eMMC (and SD) trigger supports Protocol, CMD Only / CMD+RESP, Data Settings, Error Check (CRC / Timeout), and Clause Trigger pattern match on Command / Response.

Open from the toolbar “SD/eMMC protocol trigger”. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
MMC / eMMC Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Assign CLK, CMD, AUX, and Data. AUX can gate CRC error checks by power state;cleared (AUX unused).
  • Protocol Setting: SD / MMC. Default: SD.
  • CMD Only / CMD + RESP: Changes clause depth and field / CRC rules. Default: CMD Only.
    • CMD Only: e.g. CMD18→CMD12 is 2 levels; RESP ignored.
    • CMD + RESP: e.g. CMD18→R1(CMD18)→CMD12→R1(CMD12), 4 levels.
  • tODLY Setting: Host-to-Device / Device-to-Host delay for correct latching. Default: Host-to-Device 0; Device-to-Host 5 ns.
  • Data Settings: Data pins and width. Default: 4-bit; Data DDR cleared; Data Length 512.
  • Long Idle: Idle gap between CMDs. Default: checked; 10 ms.
  • Error Check Settings: Popup for CRC7 / CRC16 / Timeout; parallel to Clause Trigger (whichever fires first).
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Command / Response formats; use Any Command first if unsure, then refine from decode. Enter a data pattern; X / XXh = Don't care; append h (hex) or b (binary). Optional DAT0 reference. Response type mainly splits fields—match still follows entered values. Custom unused-CMD entries supported (up to 8 characters per field).
Protocol and CMD Only / CMD + RESP

Error Check popup:

CRC Error Trigger popup
  • Trigger on CMD (CRC7) error: CRC check on the Command line. Default: cleared.
  • Trigger on DATA (CRC16) error: CRC check on DATA lines (set length, channels, and Write / Read CMD lists under Data Settings). Default: cleared.

Timeout Trigger popup
  • Enable Timeout: Field enables (Enable) the timeout options below. Default: cleared.
    • Trigger on Data timeout after CMD/DATA: Gap after CMD/DATA or between DATA exceeds limit. Default time 5 ms.
    • Trigger on Data IDLE timeout before CRC status: After Write DATA, CRC status missing past timeout. Default time 5 ms.
    • Trigger on Busy timeout after CRC status: After CRC status on Write DATA, Busy missing past timeout. Default time 5 ms.
    • Trigger on Busy timeout after CMD: After CMD, Busy missing past timeout. Default time 5 ms.

docs.title: Modbus Trigger
docs.text:
Modbus trigger supports Simple Trigger (Start/End of frame, Parity Error, Break/Idle) or Clause Trigger with a data pattern. TravelBus provides a dedicated UART port.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
Modbus Trigger (LA) Modbus Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

Because TravelBus has UART-specific channels, the Modbus trigger UI includes extra channel-source options.

  • Channel: UART Port/LA Port. Polarity is required for LA Port. Default is LA; polarity Default is Idle High.
  • Baud Rate: Select or type a baud rate. Default is 9600.
  • Option:
    • Parity: None/Odd/Even. Default is None.
    • Mode: ASCII/RTU. Default is ASCII (index 0). Under RTU you may check 8-N-1 (8-N-2 is common in the field).
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame, End of frame, Parity Error, Break/Idle frame. Field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: ASCII/HEX input follows ASCII/RTU mode. Rx/Tx direction and Bypass are available; HEX up to 16 bytes. Enter a data pattern; unused bytes use XXh (Don't care).

Modbus State

Modbus State example

Modbus State example

Modbus State example

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • Modbus — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: NAND Flash Trigger
docs.text:
NAND Flash trigger supports channel and data-width setup, Startup Mode, tREA / tDQSQ, commands accepted during busy, Busy time check, and Clause Trigger pattern match on Address / Command / Data.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
NAND Flash Trigger Settings
  • Channel: CLE, ALE, RE, WE, CE, R/B, DQS; optional Reverse RE / Reverse DQSchecked; Reverse RE / Reverse DQS cleared.
  • DATA: x8 / x16. Default: x8.
    • Quick Setup: Set LSB only; software assigns the rest (e.g. LSB = B0 → MSB = B7; LSB = B7 → MSB = B14). Default: checked.
    • User Defined: Open the popup to assign each data bit manually.
DATA user-defined popup
  • Startup Mode: For DDR Command / Address / Data, check DQS and Toggle / ONFI DDR Mode; ignore for SDR. Default: Init DDR cleared.
  • tREA / tDQSQ: Read data is sampled after an edge delay—tREA in SDR, tDQSQ in DDR. Default: tREA 20 ns (slider 200); tDQSQ 500 ps (slider 5).
  • Commands accepted during busy: Commands that may still trigger while Busy time check is active. Default: checked; commands 70h / FFh / 78h / 7Bh (others XXh). Leave blank to ignore commands during busy.
  • Busy time check: Check and open Setting…. Default: cleared. Up to 6 groups, 4 commands each; fires when Busy time ≥ set value.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Address, Command, Data as a data pattern; XXh / X = Don't care.

docs.title: PMBus Trigger (Power Management Bus)
docs.text:
PMBus trigger supports Simple Trigger frame events, Check PEC, Group Command, and Clause Trigger on Address / Command / Data. TravelBus may offer a dedicated port.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
PMBus Trigger (LA) PMBus Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

TravelBus adds channel-source options for PMBus because of its I2C-oriented ports.

  • Channel: I2C port or LA. Default is LA port.
  • Simple Trigger: Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK. Default: all cleared.
  • Check PEC: PEC-related trigger. Default: cleared.
  • Group Command: Default: None.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Address, Command, Data as a data pattern, or leave X / XXh.
    • Data up to 4 bytes; unused = XXh. Hex ends with h, binary with b.
    • Offset: Any Offset / Fixed Offset.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • PMBus — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: PROFIBUS Trigger (Process Field Bus)
docs.text:
Profibus trigger supports Simple Trigger (Start/End of frame), error checks (DA/SA, ED, LE, Parity, SD, Checksum), or Clause Trigger with SD data patterns.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
PROFIBUS Trigger
  • Channel: Profibus channel.
  • Settings:
    • Start bit/Input: Start-bit polarity and related input. Default input index is 0.
    • Data Rate: Baud rate. Default index is 0.
    • Parity: Default index is 0.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame/End of frame. Field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: DA/SA, ED, LE, Parity, SD, Checksum Error. Field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter SD and related fields, or keep X/XXh (Don't care).

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • PROFIBUS — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: SENT Trigger (Single Edge Nibble Transmission)
docs.text:
SENT trigger supports Simple Trigger (Enhanced/Fast/Short Start), Error Trigger (CRC/Pause/Sync), or Clause Trigger for Slow/Fast Channel data patterns.

See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
SENT Trigger
  • Channel: SENT channel. AUX field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default: cleared.
  • Startup: Tick/Nibble count/SENT version/CRC version/Pause/Message Format. Defaults: Tick index 0; Nibble count index 5; SENT version index 1; CRC version index 1; Pause index 0; Message Format index 0.
  • Simple Trigger: Enhanced/Fast/Short Start. Field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: Enhanced/Fast/Short CRC, Pause, Sync Error. Field enabled (Enable) when checked. Default all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Slow Channel Message ID/Data or Fast Channel fields. Slow Channel applies when Message is Short/Enhance; Fast Channel when Message is Fast. Unused fields use X/XXh.

docs.title: Serial Flash / SPI NAND Trigger
docs.text:
Serial Flash / SPI NAND trigger supports CS Glitch, tSHSL / tCLQV, and Clause Trigger pattern match on Command / Address / Data (including Dummy Cycles and fixed offset).

Open from the toolbar “Serial Flash protocol trigger”. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
Serial Flash / SPI NAND Trigger Settings
  • Channel: 4–6 channels depending on mode (CS / CLK / Data / AUX, etc.).
  • CS Glitch Trigger: Trigger on CS glitches; parallel to clause conditions (whichever fires first). High Pulse / Low Pulse; step 0.625 ns, max 80 ns. Default slider index is 1.
  • tSHSL / tCLQV: Adjust sliders to match device timing; unchecking tSHSL field-disables (Disable) that check. Wrong tCLQV can break Data-field matching. Default: tSHSL checked (minimum slider); tCLQV 8.75 ns.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Choose operating mode with the slider (Single / Dual / Quad / Octal, etc.); enter Command, Address, Data as a data pattern; XXh / X = Don't care. Enable fixed Data offset and set the start position (e.g. offset 0 with FFh XXh XXh XXh → Data0 = FFh, others any). Align the Dummy Cycles slider to the waveform (e.g. 8 clocks). Conditions can switch to NOT (NOT allows two Command values).

docs.title: SMBus Trigger (System Management Bus)
docs.text:
SMBus trigger can select protocol (SMBus / SBS / SPD), Simple Trigger frame events, or Clause Trigger on Address / Command / Data. TravelBus B series offers a dedicated I2C port.

Command display follows Protocols Select. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
SMBus Trigger (LA) SMBus Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)

TravelBus adds channel-source options for SMBus because of its I2C-oriented ports.

  • Channel: I2C port (TravelBus B) or LA. Default is LA port.
  • Protocols Select: SMBus / SBS / SPD. Default: index 0 (sub-menu hidden).
  • Simple Trigger: Start / Restart / Stop / ACK / NACK. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Address, Command, Data as a data pattern, or leave X / XXh.
    • Data up to 4 bytes; unused = XXh. Hex ends with h, binary with b.
    • Offset: Any Offset / Fixed Offset.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • SMBus — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: SPI Trigger (Serial Peripheral Interface)
docs.text:
SPI trigger uses Clock / CS / Data channels and Clause Trigger data patterns. Without CS, Frame guard time separates frames.

Wrong Word Size, Clock/CS polarity, or Output Delay can miss or false-trigger. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
SPI Trigger Settings
  • Channel: Clock / CS / Data0 / Data1 (2–4 channels by mode).
  • Use CS: Use Chip Select. Default: checked.
  • Frame guard time: Without CS, idle longer than this starts the next frame. Default: 10 µs.
  • Clock Mode / CS Mode: Default: index 0 for both.
  • Word Size: Default: 8.
  • Data Output Delay: Latch delay from the data edge (max 75 ns). Default: 0.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Data direction and data pattern (up to 8 bytes; unused XXh).
    • Data direction: Data In / Data Out (with Output Delay) / Dual Data / Dual Data (with Output Delay). Default: index 0 (Data In).
    • Data pattern: Default each field XXh.
    • Offset: Any Offset (Default) / Fixed Offset (offset Default 0).
Dual Data illustration

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • SPI — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: UART Trigger (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter)
docs.text:
UART trigger supports Start / End / Break / Parity Error / Stop Bit Error, plus Clause Trigger patterns on Tx / Rx.

Wrong Baud Rate or framing settings prevent triggers. TravelBus offers a dedicated UART port. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
UART Trigger (LA) UART Trigger (TravelBus; extra channel source)
  • Channel: Dedicated UART port or LA Tx / Rx channels. Default is the LA port.
  • Channel Input: Input polarity option. Default: index 0.
  • Baud Rate (Data Rate): Default: 9600.
  • Data Bits: Default: 8.
  • Parity: Default: index 0 (None).
  • Stop Bits: Default: index 0 (1 Stop).
  • Simple Trigger: Start / End / Break / Parity Error / Stop Bit Error. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter Data as a data pattern; XXh = Don't care. Up to 16 bytes; use Bypass with an offset when needed.
    • Data pattern: Default XXh (width follows Data Bits); size Default 8 frames; Hex; source Default Tx.
    • Bypass: Default cleared, offset 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • UART — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: USB Power Delivery Trigger
docs.text:
USB PD trigger supports SOP / EOP frame events, error checks (SOP / EOP / Chunk / CRC32), and Clause Trigger pattern match on SOP Sequences, Message Header, and Data Object(s).

Mismatched Data Rate versus the bus will not trigger. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
USB PD Trigger
  • Channel: Assign the CC channel.
  • Data Rate: Transmission rate (Kbps). Default: 300 Kbps.
  • Simple Trigger: SOP / EOP. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: SOP Error / EOP Error / Chunk Error / CRC32 Error. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter SOP Sequences, Message Header, Data Obj(s) as a data pattern, or leave X / XXh / XXXXh / XXXXXXXXh. Data Obj offset range: 0–7.
    • SOP Type: Default: Any.
    • Message Header / Extended Message Header: Default: XXXXh.
    • Data Obj: Default: XXXXXXXXh; Data Obj Offset Default: 0.
    • Extended Data: Each byte Default: XXh; Offset Default: 0.

docs.title: See also
docs.text: • USB Power Delivery — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.title: USB 1.1 Trigger (Universal Serial Bus)
docs.text:
USB 1.1 trigger supports frame events (Start / End of frame, SE0, Bus Idle, Idle State), error checks, and Clause Trigger pattern match on PID / Address / Frame Number / Data.

Mismatched USB Speed (Full / Low) versus the bus will not trigger. See Settings and Clause Trigger.

docs.title: Trigger Settings
docs.text:
USB 1.1 Trigger
  • Channel: Assign Dp / Dn channels.
  • USB Speed: Full Speed / Low Speed. Default: Full Speed.
  • Simple Trigger: Start of frame / End of frame / SE0 / Bus Idle / Idle State. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Error Trigger: PID Error / CRC5 Error / CRC16 Error / EOP Error / Bit Stuff Error. Field enabled (Enable) when selected. Default: all cleared.
  • Clause Trigger: See Clause Trigger.
  • State: Enter PID, Frame Number, Address, Data as a data pattern, or leave X / XXh / XXXh. Hex ends with h, binary with b.
    • PID: Default: Any.
    • Frame Number: Default: XXXh.
    • Address: Range compare (= / != / >= / <= / In Range / Not In Range). Default: =; Address Default: XXh.
    • Data: Up to 4 bytes; unused = XXh.
    • Offset: Any Offset / Fixed Offset. Default: Any Offset; offset 0.

docs.text: • USB 1.1 — Protocol Analyzer settings

docs.text:
The Clause trigger settings dialog box is as below.

Channel and protocol trigger settings:

A state button represents a trigger state. A true state condition can only branch to the next state; a false state condition can branch to any state, as shown below:

The timer ranges from 5 ns to 8 days.

This area displays the detailed trigger conditions for each level in the triggering process on the left:

You can set the logic rules between events.

You can switch or view the number of OR/AND condition combinations in this hierarchy.

Choose/ tab to add up to 8 OR/AND triggers.

The center parameter setting area varies according to the selected trigger type. Input values support base 2, 10, and 16: binary (followed by b, such as 01000001b), decimal (no suffix, such as 65), and hexadecimal (followed by h, such as 41h).

docs.title: Parallel Clause Trigger
docs.text:
The Parallel Clause Trigger feature provides 16 States, 64 Condition Resources, and 4 Timer/Counter conditions (1) to help you locate the target waveform. You can also set the State branch control flow for each IF Clause and choose whether to store the waveform.

Trigger Sample: Provides several Trigger Samples for reference; you can also combine multiple samples for a more complex trigger condition. Hold the mouse cursor over a sample to show its description and a schematic picture.

Trigger condition settings:

State button: Click to switch between Text Read Only mode and Edit mode.

State description: Click to edit a short user description for the State, maximum input text length is 80 characters.

IF Clause: Setup trigger conditions for Label selected in waveform area, and it is also available to setup AND/OR logic combination for multiple IF conditions.

Channel Logic/Edge/Pattern compare: Specify value or edge condition for each channel label, it is also available to input X as don’t care value for the comparison. Input value ended with h for hexadecimal value; input value ended with b for binary value; input value not ended with b or h for decimal value.

Timer/Counter condition check: Check Timer/Counter conditions. The condition is set to True if the Timer/Counter value matches, and to False otherwise.

Occur and Present time check: An additional Occur-times check or Present-time check when all conditions in the IF Clause are True.

Control buttons

Add new condition: Click to add new AND/OR IF condition, the new IF condition will consume 1 Condition Resource.

Advanced control button, including:

Get Value From: Set IF condition value by all Label value from selected Cursor position in the waveform area.

Copy: Copy all IF conditions of current IF Clause.

Paste: Paste the copied IF conditions into current IF Clause.

THEN Branch: Select the Branch or Trigger control flow when the IF Clause is matched (2). When select Auto, the Branch or Trigger control will be determined by current State order in the setting, the Action will be set as Trigger if current State is the last State in the setting; the Action will be set as Goto Next State if current State is NOT the last State in the setting.

Additional Then action: Setup Timer/Counter Start/Stop/Reset actions or Waveform Store Suspend/Resume for each IF Clause when condition matched.

Add new ELSE IF / ELSE Clause: Click to add a new ELSE IF / ELSE Clause. Each clause condition is checked from top to bottom, and the specified Action and Branch run when a clause condition matches. New clause conditions consume Condition Resources. If you do not assign an ELSE Clause, its condition defaults to "Anything" and it branches to the current State.

Add new State: Click to add new State Clause, the new State Clause will consume both State and Condition Resources.

Available Resources and Timer/Counter settings: Display remain available resource number and Timer/Counter settings.

Timer / Counter: Parallel Clause trigger provides 4 independent Timer/Counter resources, each resource could be selected to work in Timer or Counter mode. The minimum Timer interval is 12 Sample clock intervals (i.e. 60ns when working in 200MHz sampling mode), and the maximum Timer interval is 0x3FFFFFFF (i.e. 5s when working in 200MHz sampling mode). The minimum Counter value is 1, and the maximum Counter value is 0x3FFFFFFF.

Trigger Save/Load: You can save the current trigger settings with a description of up to 20 characters, or load previously saved trigger settings from the list. The saved settings are stored in the Working Directory as PClauseUserSetting.aqr. Copy and share the .aqr file to share the settings with another user.

Load the selected Trigger settings. You can also choose to overwrite the current Trigger settings, or to append the selected settings to the end of the current ones.

Edit the display name for the selected Trigger settings.

Delete the selected Trigger settings.

Timer / Counter features are provided in 300MHz, 250MHz, 200MHz and below sampling rate mode only.

If the trigger settings are not valid, the system holds and the status bar shows "Wait for Trigger"; you must press Stop Capture manually to retrieve the waveform.

docs.title: Protocol Trigger
docs.text:
Introduction of trigger

The trigger function uses the logic analyzer's hardware and parallel processing to check, within a limited time, whether the signal under test meets the trigger conditions, and then starts data acquisition. A good trigger function must be both accurate and flexible.

Trigger Mode

Pre-Trigger

In certain applications, when the user wants to capture signals before the trigger point, the Pre-Trigger function must be enabled. After pressing the 'Start Capture' button, the logic analyzer will wait until the data fills the memory from the beginning of the buffer to the trigger cursor before allowing the trigger circuit to start operating (it starts operating, not issuing the trigger signal). Therefore, before the logic analyzer has filled the data between the buffer and the trigger cursor, any signal that meets the trigger condition will not cause the trigger circuit to issue a trigger signal.

Post-Trigger

This is the most basic triggering method. After pressing the 'Start Capture' button, the logic analyzer will wait for the trigger to occur and then start capturing data from the position specified by the trigger cursor. Once the memory is fully filled with data, the capture will stop.

Delay-Trigger

In certain applications, when the user wants to capture signals after the trigger point and with a delay, the trigger delay function can be used to set the desired delay time. After the signal capture is successful, the trigger cursor will stop at the position where the data capture started.

Pass Count

Pass Count represents the number of times the set trigger parameters should be ignored. Under normal conditions, Pass Count is set to 0, which means data capture will start as soon as the trigger parameters are met. If set to N times, it means the trigger parameters must be met N+1 times before data capture begins. The maximum value of Pass Count will be automatically adjusted based on the specific model.

Choose to Trigger

Click on 'Trigger' in the toolbar and select the desired condition to use.

docs.title: 訊​號量​測問題
docs.text:
​訊​號量​測問題​ ​通常​有​以下​幾個​原因​:

  1. ​探棒​電容​負載​較​大時​, ​會​把​高頻​雜訊濾​掉​, ​反而​會​看​起來​很​乾淨​, ​但​實際​的​高​頻訊號​其實​也​被​濾​除​
  2. ​引線​過長​, ​引入​電感​負載​ ​把​高頻​增益​拉大​, ​頻響​規格​較​低​的​儀器​反而​會​看不出​來​
  3. ​頻率​規格​愈​高​的​儀器​ ​在​接線​不​理想​條件​下​ ​會​看到​更​糟糕​的​結果​, ​因為​它​能​讓​高​頻訊號​通過​, ​呈​現出​更​多​的​雜訊​反應​
  4. ​測量​訊號​的​引線​ ​與​ ​自身​迴​路​的​地線​ ​距離​遠遠​近近​, ​造成​阻抗​變異​ ​引起​多重​反射​, ​所以​ ​測試​訊​號配​對​的​地線​ ​就要​接在訊號​旁邊​
  5. ​測量​引線​ ​是​由​ ​原電路​ ​拉​引線​出來​, ​形成​ ​電路​分支​/stub ​造成​阻抗​斷點​, ​需加​ 20 - 50 ohm ​電阻​ ​避免​二次​反射​
  6. ​不同​探棒​的​ ​輸入​阻抗​ ​與​ ​引線​ ​的​配置​不同​, ​所以​與​ DUT ​連接​後​的​現象​也​會​有​差異​, ​但​如果​引線夠​短​ ​且​能​避免​二次​反射​ ​以及​ ​訊號​/Gnd ​保持​近距​離以​維持​阻抗​穩定​, ​那​這樣​才​會​符合​儀器​本身​的​規格​

  2. ​以​ ​高取​樣率​ ​擷取​
  3. ​使用​ ​堆疊​示波器​ ​檢視類​比​波形​
  4. ​以​ ​軟體​濾波器​ ​比較​濾波​前後結果​

​適用​情境​： ​識別​雜訊​、​毛刺​或訊號​品質​問題​。

docs.title: 文件​結構
docs.text:
​快速​入門​

  • ​了解​介面​：​認識​ UI ​元件​與​版面​配置​
  • ​快速​開始​教學​：​初學者​逐步​導覽​

​擷​取訊號​

  • ​擷取​設定​：​設定​觸發​、​記憶體​與​臨界值​
  • ​觸發​設定​：​設定觸​發類​型​與​條件​
  • ​進階擷​取​設定​：​非​同步​/​同步​模式​與​毛刺​濾波​

​分析​波形​

  • ​瀏覽​波形​資料​：​瀏覽​已​擷取​的​資料​
  • ​通道​標​籤​：​自訂​通道​標​籤​
  • ​游標​量測​：​以游標​進行​精確​時序​量測​
  • ​瀏覽​報告​：​瀏覽​分析​結果​

​檔案​操作​

  • ​開啟​與​儲存​檔案​：​管理​波形​檔案​與​匯入​資料​
  • ​匯出​資料​：​匯出​為​多種​格式​與​批次​操作​

​進階​功能​

  • ​電源​序列​驗證​：​以自訂​時序​設定​檔​自動化​水平​時序驗證​
  • ​堆疊​外部​示波器​：​整合​外部​示波器​進行​分析​

​偏好​設定​

  • ​環境​選項​：​環境​設定​集合​
  • ​鍵盤​快捷​鍵​：​管理​常用​快捷​鍵​

docs.title: 進階擷​取​設定
docs.text:
​除了​上​一節​介紹​的​基本​擷取​設定​外​，​我們​也​提供​以下​進階擷​取​設定​供​您​選擇​。​詳細​說明​如下​：

​進階擷​取​設定

docs.title: Asynchronous Mode / Synchronous Mode
docs.text: 非​同步​模式​ / ​同步​模式​清單

docs.title: Asynchronous Mode (Timing Analysis)
docs.text:
​非​同步​模式​（Asynchronous Mode）​使用​裝置​內部​時脈​作為​取樣​時脈​。​此​模式​在​大多​數情況​下​為​預設​模式​。​它會​以​固定​時脈​速率​持續​取樣​，​並​要求​訊​號經​過過​取樣​（oversampling）​才能​取得​準確​的​時序​。

Tip

​一般​建議​取樣​率​至少​為訊號​頻率​的​ 5 ​至​ 10 ​倍​。​取樣​率​低​於​訊號​頻率​的​ 5 ​倍會​造成​訊號​失真​。

Compound Mode

​我們​也​支援​複​合時​脈​（compound clocks），​將​外部​時脈​與​內部​時脈​結合​形成​新​的​取樣​時脈​。

​支援​兩種​模式​：

  • Asynchronous Mode (Record When CK0 = 0)：​僅在​外部​時脈​為​ LOW ​時​錄​製​
  • Asynchronous Mode (Record When CK0 = 1)：​僅在​外部​時脈​為​ HIGH ​時​錄​製​

​範例​： ​當​ SPI Chip Select (CS) ​為​ 0 ​時擷​取訊號​：

  • ​選擇​非​同步​模式​（CK0 = 0 ​時​錄​製​）
  • ​限定​條件​會將​擷取​篩選​為僅​在​ CK0 ​符合​條件​時​進行​

docs.title: Synchronous Mode (State Analysis)
docs.text:
​與​非​同步​模式​不同​，​同步​模式​（Synchronous Mode）​使用​外部​輸入​時脈​作為​取樣​時脈​。

​同步​模式​提供​以下​預設​模式​：

  • Synchronous Mode (Latch on CK0 Rising)：​在​外部​時脈​上升​邊緣​取樣​
  • Synchronous Mode (Latch on CK0 Falling)：​在​外部​時脈​下降​邊緣​取樣​
  • Synchronous Mode (Latch on CK0 Either)：​在​外部​時脈​上升​或​下降​邊緣​取樣​

​設定​：

  • ​訊​號線​上​的​ CK0 ​通道​為​外部​時脈​輸入​
  • ​外部​時脈​停止​時​，​訊號​擷取​也​會​停止​
  • ​在​裝置​與​外部​時脈​之間​建立​同步​運作​

docs.title: Advanced Settings
docs.text:
​設定​多​組邊​緣​條件​以​同時​取樣​。

​運作​方式​：

​每組邊​緣​條件​包含​兩組​限定​條件​（qualifier sets）。​任一​限定​條件​符合​時即​立即​取樣​。

​條件​範例​：

  • CK0 ↑ → ​立即​取樣​

  • CK0 ↑ + CK1 = 0 → ​立即​取樣​

docs.title: Glitch Filter
docs.text:
​我們​提供​毛刺​濾波器​（Glitch Filter）​功能​，​用​於​抑制​錄​製​資​料​中​的​短​脈​衝​，​並​消除​這些​短脈衝​造成​的​錯誤​邏輯​狀態​。​這是​錄​製​過​程​中常​見​的​問題​，​因為​我們​無法​保證​環境​中不會​引入​雜訊​。

Tip

​使用​示波器​分析​訊號​品質​。​盡​可能​消除​雜訊以​取得​更好​的​結果​。

docs.title: Hardware Glitch Filter
docs.text:
​此​功能​在​開始​擷​取前​套用​低通​濾波​。​濾波​由​硬體​完成​，​因此​資料​擷取​完成​後​無法​停用​。

​硬體​毛刺​濾波器​設定​

​濾波​範圍​：5ns ​至​ 35ns

​使用​硬體​毛刺​濾波器​的​通道​會​在​通道​標​籤​上​以​ ​紅點​ ​標示​，​方便​識別​。

docs.title: Software Glitch Filter
docs.text:
​擷取​完成​後​濾​除訊號​，​不影響​觸發​或​時序​。

​軟體​毛刺​濾波器​設定​

​濾波​範圍​：1ps ​至​ 1ms

​特性​

  • ​僅變​更​顯示​與​解碼​內容​
  • ​不會​ ​影響​觸發​
  • ​不會​ ​影響​可​錄​製​時​間​
  • ​停用​濾波器​可​還原​原始​未濾波​波形​

​相較​硬體​濾波器​的​優點​：

  • ​更​寬​的​濾​波範圍​（1ps ​至​ 1ms，​相對​硬體​的​ 5ns ​至​ 35ns）
  • ​非破​壞性​：​保留​原始​錄​製​資​料​
  • ​可切換​ ENABLE ​或​ DISABLE ​以比較​濾波​前後結果​

docs.title: 匯流​排解​碼設定
docs.text:
​設定​匯流​排協定​解碼​，​並​建立​自訂​的​解碼​報告​。

​各匯​流排​的​解碼​參數​、​觸發​條件​、​進階選項​與​時序​需求​，​都​收錄​在​ ​協定​說明​ ​章節​，​每個​協定​一頁​。​本頁​說明​自訂​解碼​報告​，​其​操作​方式​對​所有​協定​皆​相同​。

docs.title: 自訂​報告​設定
docs.text: ​從多個​匯流​排解​碼器​挑選​欄位​，​組​合成​自訂​的​解碼​報告​。

docs.title: 概覽
docs.text: ​波形​區中​啟用​的​所有​匯流​排解​碼器​都​會​出現​在​自訂​報告​設定​視窗​。​從​每個​解碼器​選取​欄位​，​將它​們​合​併​成​一份​統一​的​自訂​報告​。

docs.title: 設定​步驟
docs.text:
1. ​啟用​匯流​排解​碼器​： ​在​波形​區​加入​並設定​所​需​的​匯流​排解​碼​通道​

  2. ​開啟​設定​： ​進入​自訂​報告​設定​對​話​框​

  3. ​選取​欄位​： ​選擇​要​從​各​匯流​排解​碼器​報告​納入​哪些​欄位​

  4. ​位址​欄​
  5. ​資料​欄​
  6. ​控制​訊​號欄​
  7. ​狀態​資訊​

  8. ​時序​資訊​

  9. ​預覽​： ​預覽視​窗會​顯示​已​選取​的​欄位​數量​，​並呈​現合​併​後​的​報告​結構​

  10. ​套用​： ​以所選​欄位​建立​自訂​報告​

docs.title: 需求
docs.text:
​重要​： ​匯流​排解​碼器​必須​設定​正確​，​才能​取得​自訂​報告​所​需​的​正確​欄位​名稱​。

​設定檢​查清​單​：

  • ​正確​設定​協定​類型​
  • ​為​匯流​排訊號​指派​正確​的​通道​
  • ​設定​適當​的​解碼​參數​
  • ​建立​自訂​報告​前​，​先確​認解碼​已​正常​運作​

docs.title: 合​併​多種​協定
docs.text:
​範例​： I2C + SPI ​合​併​報告​

  • ​顯示​ I2C ​位址​與​資料​
  • ​顯示​ SPI chip select ​與​資料​
  • ​對照​兩條​匯流​排之間​的​時序​

​優點​：

  • ​以單​一檢視​觀察多​匯流​排系統​
  • ​更​容易​在​協定​之間​相互​對照​
  • ​簡化​匯出​以​供​製​作​文件​

docs.title: 聚焦​特定​資料
docs.text:
​範例​： ​只​保留​必要​欄位​

  • ​移除​多餘​的​狀態​欄​
  • ​只​保留​位址​與​資料​
  • ​為​特定​分析​簡化​報告​

​優點​：

  • ​報告​更​乾淨​、​更​聚焦​
  • ​視覺​掃視​更​快​
  • ​匯出​檔案​更​小​

docs.title: 建立​標準化​報告
docs.text:
​範例​： ​團隊​標準​報告​格式​

  • ​所有​測試​設定​使用​相同​欄位​
  • ​一致​的​命名​與​順序​
  • ​更​容易​在​測試​之間​比​對​

​優點​：

  • ​團隊​一致性​
  • ​更​容易​審閱​與​協作​
  • ​標準化​文件​

docs.title: 顯示​列號
docs.text:
​在​系統​環境​設定​中​啟用​列號​，​即可​在​報告區​左側​顯示​列號​。

​優點​：

  • ​更​容易​參考​特定​交易​
  • ​討論​結果​時​溝通​更​清楚​
  • ​大型​報告​中導覽​更​簡單​

docs.title: 時間​戳​格式
docs.text:
​在​系統​環境​設定​中選擇​時間​戳​的​顯示​格式​：

  • ​時序​資訊​格式​： ​從觸​發點​起算​的​相​對​時間​
  • ​含​日期​時間​的​時序​資訊​： ​絕對​時間​戳​（​觸發點​為​ 0s）
  • ​取樣​點數​格式​： ​以取​樣點​編號​取代​時間​

docs.title: 匯​出自​訂​報告
docs.text:
​使用​標準​匯出​功能​儲存​自訂​報告​：

  • ​單一​檔案​匯出​（​目前​視窗​）
  • ​批次​報告​匯出​（​多個​檔案​）
  • CSV ​或​ TXT ​格式​

docs.title: 擷取​設定
docs.text:
​開始​擷取​資料​前​，​請​先​完成​以下​重要​設定​。

  • ​取樣​率​
  • ​通道​設定​
  • ​儲存​模式​
  • ​臨界值​
  • ​觸發​設定​

docs.title: Sample Rate
docs.text:
​一般​建議​取樣​率​至少​為訊號​頻率​的​ 5 ​至​ 10 ​倍​。​若​需要​，​您​也​可以​設定​更​高​的​取樣​率​；​這​通常​能​提升​擷取​資料​的​時序​解析度​。​不過​，​取樣​率過​高​也​可能​增加​資料​毛刺​的​機率​，​進而​影響​資料​解讀​。

​範例​：

  • I2C 100 kHz → ​使用​ 1 MHz ​或​更​高​
  • SPI 1 MHz → ​使用​ 10 MHz ​或​更​高​

Tip

​快速​設定​（Quick Settings） ​已針​對​多數​協定​自動​符合​此​原則​。

​在​工具​列中點​選​ Sample Rate（​取樣​率​） ​按鈕​即可​設定​取樣​率​。

​取樣​率​下拉選單​

Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​的​取樣​率​設定​位置​略有不同​，​如下​所示​。

Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​的​取樣​率​設定

docs.title: Channel Settings
docs.text:
​設定​用​於​擷取​資料​的​通道​數量​。​請​注意​，​此​設定​必須​在​開始​擷​取前​完成​。​若有​通道​未​使用​，​可將​其​停用​以節​省​記憶體​。

​通道​設定​

Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​的​通道​設定

docs.title: Storage Modes
docs.text:
​設定​擷取​資料​的​儲存​方式​。

​儲存​模式​

Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​的​儲存​模式​

​下圖​說​明三種​主要​儲存​模式​的​差異​。

​儲存​模式​比較

docs.title: Store to Device RAM
docs.text:
​此​模式​為​預設​模式​。​錄​製​資​料​會​暫​存​於​裝​置​ RAM ​中​。​記憶體​滿載​時​，​擷​取會​停止​，​資料​隨即​傳輸​至​ PC。

​您​可以​設定​擷取​資料​的​儲存​深度​。​單次​擷​取會​在​達​到​儲存​深度​上限​時​停止​。​上限​因機型​而​異​。

​此​模式​也​會​顯示​預估​可​錄​製​時​間​，​協​助您​決定​所​需​的​記憶體​大小​。

docs.title: Stream to PC RAM
docs.text:
​錄​製​資​料​先​由​裝​置​ RAM ​緩衝​，​再​即​時​串流​至​ PC RAM。​若​ PC ​有足夠​的​ RAM，​此​模式​相當​實用​。

Warning

USB ​傳輸​吞吐量​會​造成​限制​。​因此​不建議​在​高​取樣​率​下​使用​此​模式​，​因為​短​時間​內會產生​大量​資料​。

docs.title: Stream to PC HDD (Waveform Logger)
docs.text: ​此​模式​會進​一步​將資料​儲存​至​硬碟​，​因為​硬碟​通常​有​更​大​的​儲存​空間​。​建議​用​於​長​時間​擷取​，​但​限制​與​ Stream to PC RAM ​模式​相同​。

docs.title: Transitional Storage
docs.text:
​過渡​儲存​（Transitional Storage）​適用​於​ Store to Device RAM ​與​ Stream to PC RAM ​模式​。​此​功能​僅儲存​狀態​轉換​，​而​非​整段​擷取​的​所有​取樣點​，​讓​您​得以​擷取​更長​時間​的​資料​。

Tip

​當訊​號長​時間​處​於​閒置​狀態​，​但​您​仍​想長​時間​擷取​資料​時​，​強烈​建議​使用​此​模式​。

docs.title: Trigger Position
docs.text:
​以​百分比​設定觸​發點​在​記憶體​中​的​位置​。

  • ​範例​： 50% ​表示​裝置​記憶體​中​最​多​ 50% ​用​於​儲存觸​發前​資料​
  • ​擷取​停止​條件​： ​設定​擷​取自​動​停止​的​時機​

docs.title: Threshold Voltage Level Configuration
docs.text:
​設定​決定​擷​取訊號​邏輯​位準​的​電壓​臨界值​。

Tip

​經驗​法則​： ​臨界值​ = ​供電電壓​ ÷ 2。​這是​取得​良好​結果​的​起始​設定​。

  1. ​點選​工具​列中​的​ Threshold（​臨界值​） ​按鈕​

  2. ​從​ Quick Setup（​快速​設定​） ​下拉選​單選擇​預設值​，​或​自訂​電壓​

    ​常見​電壓​位準​：

    • Vcc 5 V：​將臨界值​設為​ 2.5 V
    • Vcc 3.3 V：​將臨界值​設為​ 1.6 V
    • Vcc 1.8 V：​將臨界值​設為​ 0.9 V

  3. ​點選​ OK

​經驗​法則​： ​臨界值​ = ​供電電壓​ ÷ 2

​臨界值​設定​

Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​的​臨界值​設定

docs.title: Threshold Configuration with Schmitt Circuit
docs.text:
​為何​使用​ Schmitt ​電路​？

​使用​單一​臨界值​時​，​若訊號​轉換​期間​電壓​接近​臨界值​，​裝置​可能​擷取​到​不明​確的​ 0 ​或​ 1 ​狀態​，​造成​檢視​困難​。

​實際訊​號常​包含​：

  • ​雜訊​
  • ​緩慢​邊緣​
  • ​彈跳訊號​（​開關​）

​這會​使​波形​分析​變得​困難​，​因為訊號​可能​被​擷​取為​不明​確的​狀態​，​如下​圖​所示​。

​硬體​突波濾​波器​的​限制​

​硬體​突波濾​波器​（​低通濾​波器​）​可濾除​雜訊​，​但​也​可能​濾掉​真​實訊號​或​高頻​成分​，​因此​不​適合解​決此​問題​。

Schmitt ​電路​解決​方案​

​使用​兩組​臨界值​在​電壓訊號​上​建立​遲滯​（hysteresis），​消除​雜訊​干擾​並解​決訊號​抖動​問題​。

​設定​

​使用​ Schmitt ​電路​功能​時​：

  • ​兩個​通道​都​必須​用​於​量測​
  • ​每個量​測點​需要​兩條​測試線​，​以​形成​兩組​臨界值​

​通道​配對​

TravelLogic ​系列​可​如下​配對​通道​：

  • ​第一​組臨界值​：CH0 - CH15
  • ​第二​組臨界值​：CH16 - CH31
  • ​配對​：CH0 ↔ CH16、CH1 ↔ CH17、CH2 ↔ CH18，​以此​類推​

​如何​判定​邏輯​位準​？

  • ​輸入​訊號​必須​ ​高​於​ Upper Threshold（​上​臨界值​） ​才​會​切換​為​邏輯​ 1（HIGH）
  • ​輸入​訊號​必須​ ​低​於​ Lower Threshold（​下​臨界值​） ​才​會​切換​為​邏輯​ 0（LOW）
  • ​當輸​入介​於​兩​臨界值​之間​時​，​輸出​維持​先前​的​邏輯​狀態​。

docs.title: 通道​標​籤
docs.text: ​現在​我們​聚焦​於​介面​左側​的​通道​標​籤​區域​。​您​可以​在​此​管理​所有​通道​、​匯流排​與​協定​解碼器​。

docs.title: 通道​標​籤​區域​顯示​哪些​內容​？
docs.text:
• ​通道​名稱​與​編號​
  • ​匯流排​群組​
  • ​協定​解碼​設定​
  • ​訊號​活動​指示器​（​若​已​啟用​）
  • ​觸發​條件​（​若​已​啟用​）

docs.title: Analog Channel
docs.text:
Note

​僅適​用​於​ Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope ​系列​。

docs.title: Protocol Decoder
docs.text: ​對​於​協定​解碼器​，​標​籤​右上角​有​一個​ ​圖示​。​按​一下​該​圖示​即可​開啟​協定​解碼器​設定​對​話​方塊​。

docs.title: 新增​通道
docs.text: ​按​一下​ ​圖示​後​，​會彈​出​下拉清單​，​顯示​可​新增​的​選項​。

docs.title: 刪除​通道
docs.text: ​先選取​要​刪除​的​標​籤​，​再​按​一下​ ​按鈕​以​刪除​所​選標​籤​。

docs.title: 合​併​通道
docs.text: ​將一個​標​籤​拖曳​至​另​一個標​籤​上​，​即可​形成​並列​匯流排​。

docs.title: 自訂
docs.text:
​在​通道​標​籤​上​按​一下​滑鼠​左鍵​，​即可​開啟​通道​設定​對​話​方塊​。

​這讓​您​可以​：

  • ​從​ Signal ​下拉清​單選擇​來源​，​以調​整此​通道​標​籤​的​來源​（​不會變​更​實際​錄​製​的​資​料​）
  • ​編輯​文字​欄位​以​重新命名​通道​
  • ​編輯​ Display Format
  • ​編輯​ Colors
  • ​選擇​是否​使用​ inverted display

Tip

​請​使用​具​描述性​的​名稱​，​例如​ "SDA"、"Clock"、"CS"，​而​非​ "CH0"、"CH1"，​以便​更​容易​理解​。

​對​於​協定​解碼器​，​您​可以​勾選​ Suspend Decode ​核取​方塊​，​以​防止​解碼器​在​波形​區​重新整理​後​分析​資料​。

docs.title: 游標​操作
docs.text: ​游標​在​瀏覽​與​分析​擷取​資料​時​扮演​關鍵​角色​。​您​不僅​可以​使用​游標​快速​跳至​波形​區的​特定​位置​，​還能​進行​精確​的​時間​間​隔​與​頻率​量測​，​以及​進階​的​波形​搜尋​。

docs.title: 概覽
docs.text:
游標​控制面板​

​游標​可以​在​波形​區中​新增​、​刪除​，​並​拖曳​至​任何​位置​。

docs.title: 特殊​用途​游標
docs.text: T cursor：​標記觸​發點​（​通常​位​於​固定​位置​）。​此游標​通常​為紅色​。

docs.title: 新增​游標
docs.text:
​這會​自動​在​最後一個​游標​之​後​新增​一個​游標​（​字母​從​ A ​遞​增至​ Z）。

Tip

​鍵盤​快捷​鍵​：​按​ Shift + A-Z ​鍵​可​在​滑鼠​位置​新增​游標​。

docs.title: 刪除​游標
docs.text: ​會彈​出​下拉清單​，​顯示​可​刪除​的​現有​游標​，​或​按​一下​ Delete All ​按鈕​一次​刪除​全部​。

docs.title: Move To
docs.text:
​快速​跳至​波形​區的​特定​位置​。

​快捷​鍵​：​按​ A-Z ​鍵​可​快速​跳​至​對​應​的​游標​位置​。

​可用​位置​：

  • Waveform start：​移至​擷取​波形​的​開頭​
  • First transition：​移至​任何​通道​上​的​第一​個​波形​轉換​
  • First transition on selected label：​移至​特定​通道​標​籤​的​第一​個​轉換​
  • Waveform end：​移至​擷取​波形​的​結尾​
  • Last transition：​移至​任何​通道​上​的​最後一個​波形​轉換​
  • Last transition on selected label：​移至​特定​通道​標​籤​的​最後一個​轉換​
  • Trigger position：​移至​觸發點​（​即​ T cursor）

  • Cursor A-Z：​移至​任何​具名​游標​位置​

    Tip

    ​鍵盤​快捷​鍵​：​按​ A-Z ​鍵​可​快速​跳​至​對​應​的​游標​位置​。

docs.title: Waveform Search by Cursors
docs.text: ​使用​四種​搜尋​模式​尋找​特定​訊號​模式​。

docs.title: 1. By Edge
docs.text: ​依​指定​通道​的​ Rising / Falling / Either ​邊緣​次數​（x1 ~ x4096），​移動​指定​游標​位置​。

docs.title: 2. By Time
docs.text: ​將​指定​游標​位置​向前​或​向​後​移動​指定​的​時間​量​。

docs.title: 3. By Value Match
docs.text: ​搜尋​指定​通道​的​顯​示值​內容​；​若​指定​通道​為​匯流​排協定​，​則以​文字​比對​進行​搜尋​；​若​指定​通道​為​匯流排​或​通道​，​則以​數值​比​對​進行​搜尋​。

docs.title: 4. Search Pulse Width
docs.text: ​在​指定​通道​上​搜尋​符合​條件​的​波形​脈衝​寬度​。​左側​的​單游標​移動​功能​或​右側​的​多​游標​移動​功能​，​皆​可用​於​符合​或​超出​條件​的​任何​操作​。

docs.title: 使用​游標​量測
docs.text:
​介面​右下角​有量​測顯​示列​，​顯示​游標​之間​的​量​測值​。​移動​游標​時會​自動​更新​。​您​也​可以​按​一下​ A-Z ​按鈕​手動​編輯​游標配​對​。

​此外​，​您​可以​使用量​測顯示​列右側​的​圖示​變​更量測​的​顯示​格式​。

  1. Interval time：​所選游標​與​參考​游標​之間​的​時間​
  2. Frequency calculation：​頻率​ = 1 / ​間​隔​時間​
  3. Sampling statistics：​游標​之間​的​取樣數​，​取決​於​擷取​資料​的​取樣​率​。

docs.title: 多​重量​測
docs.text: ​您​可以​在​ ​系統​環境​設定​ ​中設​定游​標量​測群組​的​最大​數量​（3–10）。​預設​為​ 3。

docs.title: 匯出​資料
docs.text: ​將擷​取​的​波形​與​解碼​報告​匯出​為​多種​格式​，​供​文件​撰寫​、​分析​與訊號​再生​使用​。

docs.title: 另存​新檔​匯出​格式
docs.text:
​以多種​格式​儲存​擷取​的​波形​，​以​符合​不同​用途​。

​可用​格式​：

  1. TravelLogic ​檔案​ (*.TLW) — ​原生​格式​，​保留​所有​設定​
  2. ​過渡​文字​檔​ (*.txt) — ​僅含​過渡​資料​（​檔案​較​小​）
  3. ​文字​檔​ (*.txt) — ​完整​資料​匯出​
  4. MATLAB ​陣列​檔​ (*.m) — ​供​ MATLAB ​分析​與​處理​
  5. ​二​進位​資料​檔​ (*.bin) — ​原始​二​進位​格式​
  6. TravelLogic ​檔案​ + ​報告​檔​ (.TLW + .TXT) — ​波形​與​解碼​報告​一​併​匯出​
  7. Value Change Dump (*.vcd) — ​標準​ VCD ​格式​，​供模擬​工具​與​波形​檢視器​使用​
  8. ​時間​戳​記二​進位​檔​ (*.bin) — ​含時間​戳記​的​二​進位​資料​，​選項​包括​：
  9. 64 ​位元​時間​ + 16 ​位元​資料​
  10. 64 ​位元​時間​ + 32 ​位元​資料​
  11. 64 ​位元​時間​ + 64 ​位元​資料​
  12. 64 ​位元​時間​ + 128 ​位元​資料​

​時間​戳​記二​進位​格式​：

​前​ 64 ​位元​代表​時間​，​其餘位​元​代表​資料​。​資料​方向​由​ LSB ​至​ MSB（​由​左​至​右​）。

​注意​： ​若選擇​的​資料​位元​格式​位元​數少​於​通道​數​，​多餘位​元將​被​捨​棄​。

​儲存​範圍​選項​：

​使用​「​另存​新檔​」​時​，​可選擇​指定​儲存​範圍​，​僅匯出​部分​擷取​資料​：

  • ​完整​波形​
  • ​僅游​標範圍​
  • ​自訂​時間​範圍​

docs.title: 另存​為​ DGW / PGV ​檔
docs.text:
​將擷​取​的​波形​轉換​為​ DGW/PGV ​格式​，​供​ Acute ​數位​資料​產生器​（PKPG、PG2000、DG ​系列​、TD ​系列​）​使用​。​匯出​的​波形​可用​於​再生​數位​訊號​。

​設定​選項​：

  1. ​選擇​ PG ​型號​： ​軟體​依所​選型​號檢查​最大​工作​頻率​與​記憶體​深度​
  2. ​檔名​與​位置​： ​指定​轉換​後​ PGV ​檔​的​儲存​位置​
  3. ​儲存​範圍​：
  4. ​游標​範圍​內​的​波形​
  5. ​最大​可用​範圍​（​依​ PG ​最大​記憶體​而定​）
  6. ​注意​： ​超過​ PG ​記憶體​的​檔案​可能​無法​在​ PG ​軟體​中​開啟​
  7. ​重​複​輸出​： ​在​結尾​加入​「Jump to start」​指令​以連續​播放​
  8. Idle ​轉換​方式​： ​以​迴​圈​指令​取代​長​時間​ idle ​以節​省​記憶體​
  9. ​警告​： ​這會​使​波形​更​複​雜​、​較難​編輯​
  10. PG ​工作​頻率​： ​指定​目標​ Pattern Generator ​頻率​
  11. ​波形​轉換​方式​： ​選擇​如何​處理​頻率​不​匹配​：
  12. ​即時​取樣​模式​： ​使用​ PG ​最大​頻率​（​可能​遺失​小訊號​）
  13. ​較慢​波形​模式​： ​將​高速​波形​轉為​較​慢速度​（​可能​影響​ setup/hold ​時序​）

​使用​情境​：

  • ​重播​擷​取訊號​以​進行​測試​
  • ​從​真​實訊號​建立​測試​圖樣​
  • ​以​已知​良好​波形​進行​除錯​
  • ​產生驗​證用​的​激勵​訊號​

docs.title: 儲存​報告​內容
docs.text:
​將匯流​排解​碼結果​與​統計​資料​匯出​為​文字​檔​，​供​文件​或進​一步​分析​使用​。

​匯出​方式​：

  1. ​移至​波形​下方​的​報告區​
  2. ​按​一下​報告​視窗​工具​列中​的​儲存​按鈕​
  3. ​選擇​格式​與​位置​

​支援​格式​：

  • .CSV（Comma-Separated Values）：​供試​算表​分析​
  • .TXT（Plain text）：​供​文件​使用​

​包含​內容​：

  • ​解碼​結果​
  • ​時間​戳記​
  • ​通道​狀態​
  • ​自訂​報告​欄位​
  • ​統計​資料​（​若​已​設定​）

​請​參閱​：​匯流​排解​碼設定​，​在​匯出​前​自訂​報告​欄位​。

docs.title: 批次​報告​儲存
docs.text:
​一次​從多個​擷取​波形​檔產生​解碼​報告​。

​設定​：

  1. ​來源​檔案​： ​選擇​ .TLW ​或​ .LAW ​波形​檔​
  2. ​輸出​目錄​： ​選擇​轉換​後​報告​的​儲存​位置​
  3. ​副​檔名​： ​選擇​ .CSV ​或​ .TXT ​格式​
  4. ​解碼​設定​：
  5. ​使用​各檔案​各自​的​解碼​設定​
  6. ​對​所有​轉換​使用​指定​檔案​的​解碼​設定​
  7. ​報告​格式​：
  8. ​將報​告儲存​為​個​別​檔案​
  9. ​合​併​所有​報告​為​單一​檔案​，​並以​分隔​文字​區隔​
  10. ​包含​選項​：
  11. ​時間​戳​記欄位​資訊​
  12. ​標題​欄位​資訊​

​使用​情境​：

  • ​一次​處理​多筆​測試​執行​
  • ​為​生產紀​錄產生​報告​
  • ​批次​轉換​以供​歸檔​
  • ​從多筆​擷取​建立​標準化​報告​

docs.title: 選擇​合適​格式
docs.text:
​供​其他​工具​分析​：

  • ​使用​ .VCD ​供​波形​檢視器​（GTKWave ​等​）
  • ​使用​ .CSV ​供試​算表​分析​
  • ​使用​ .MATLAB ​供訊號​處理​

​供​文件​使用​：

  • ​使用​ .TXT ​產生​可讀​報告​
  • ​使用​ .TLW + .TXT ​建立​完整​歸檔​
  • ​包含​時間​戳記​以利​追溯​

​供訊號​再生​：

  • ​使用​ .DGW/.PGV ​供​ Acute Pattern Generator
  • ​匯​出游​標範圍​以​聚焦​特定​事件​
  • ​長​時間​擷取​可​考慮​ idle ​最佳化​

docs.title: 檔案​大小​管理
docs.text:
​大型​擷取​：

  • ​使用​過渡​文字​格式​以縮​小​檔案​
  • ​盡​可能​僅匯​出游​標範圍​
  • ​使用​二​進位​格式​以​高效​儲存​

​批次​操作​：

  • ​大量​批次​可​在​離峰​時段​處理​
  • ​使用​一致​的​解碼​設定​以便​比​對​
  • ​分析​相關​擷​取時​可合​併​報告​

docs.title: 相關​主題
docs.text:
• ​檔案​操作​：​開啟​與​儲存​波形​檔​
  • ​報告區​：​匯出​前​設定​報告​顯示​
  • ​匯流​排解​碼​：​匯出​報告​前​先​設定​解碼​

docs.title: 檔案​操作
docs.text: ​從​各種​來源​開啟​、​儲存​及​匯入​波形​檔​。

docs.title: 開啟​檔案
docs.text:
​從​磁碟​載入​先前​儲存​的​波形​檔​。

​支援​格式​：

  • TravelLogic ​波形​檔​ (*.TLW)
  • ​邏輯​分析​儀​波形​檔​ (*.LAW)

docs.title: 儲存​檔案
docs.text: ​以現​有​檔​名將​目前​擷取​結果​儲存​至​磁碟​。

docs.title: 另存​新檔
docs.text:
​以新​檔名​儲存​，​並可選擇​指定​儲存​範圍​。

​主要​格式​：

  • TravelLogic ​檔案​ (*.TLW) — ​原生​格式​，​保留​所有​設定​

​其他​格式​： ​若要​匯出​為​其他​格式​，​請​參閱​ ​匯出​資料​。

docs.title: 全部​儲存
docs.text:
​一次​將​所有​開啟​的​邏輯​分析​儀​與​協定​分析​儀視​窗儲存​至​檔案​。

​使用​情境​： ​在​一次​操作​中​快速​儲存​來​自​不同​視窗​的​多筆​擷取​結果​。

docs.title: 匯入​ CSV
docs.text:
​將以​文字​格式​儲存​的​數位​或類​比資料​轉換​為​ TLW ​格式​，​以便​檢視​與​分析​。

​位置​： ​工具​列​ → ​檔案​（File）→ ​匯入​ CSV（Import CSV）

​需求​： ​必須​連接​硬體​裝置​。

​支援​格式​：

docs.title: 1. Agilent LA Module CSV ​文字​檔
docs.text:
​從​ Agilent LA ​軟體​匯出​ Module CSV ​文字​檔​格式​。

​從​ Agilent ​軟體​匯出​：

  • ​開啟​ .Ala ​檔​
  • ​工具​列​ → ​檔案​（File）→ ​匯出​（Export...）
  • ​選擇​ Module CSV Text File ​格式​

docs.title: 2. Tektronix TLA ​資料​交換​格式
docs.text:
​從​ TLA ​軟體​匯出​ Data Exchange Format。

​從​ TLA ​軟體​匯出​：

  • ​按​一下​ ​檔案​（File）→ ​匯出​資料​（Export Data...）
  • ​選擇​ TLA Data Exchange Format

docs.title: 3. LA ​文字​檔
docs.text:
​匯入​可​自訂​格式​設定​的​通用​文字​檔​。

​需設定​的​項目​：

  • ​分隔​字​元​
  • ​資料​起始​列​（​用作​通道​標​籤​名稱​）
  • ​時間​欄位​格式​

docs.title: 4. DSO ​文字​檔
docs.text:
​從​支援​的​裝置​匯入​示波器​波形​資料​。

​支援​裝置​：

  • BF6264B、BF7000 ​系列​、BF7264 Pro
  • LA3068B、LA3134B、LA4068B、LA4136B
  • TL3134B、TL3234B+、TL4131B、TL4234B

​功能​：

  • ​可選擇​多個​檔案​匯入​
  • ​可為​各​檔案​設定​個別​資料​處理​模式​
  • ​從前​ 10 ​列自動​偵測​取樣​率​／​間​隔​與​觸發​位置​

​單位​指定​：

​必須​指定​電壓​量測​的​基本​單位​：

​以​ mV ​為例​（​預設​）：

  • ​資料值​：1357
  • ​解讀​為​：1.357V

​以​ μV ​為例​：

  • ​資料值​：135790
  • ​解讀​為​：0.13579V

​差動訊號​模式​：

  • ​正負​通道​設定​必須​一致​
  • ​正負​通道​數量​必須​相等​

docs.title: 5. ​自訂​格式
docs.text: ​依所​需​格式​排列​資料​，​以匯入​其他​邏輯​分析​儀​的​波形​。

docs.title: 支援​的​檔案​格式
docs.text:
​開啟​：

  • *.TLW（TravelLogic Waveform）：​原生​格式​，​保留​完整​設定​
  • *.LAW（Logic Analyzer Waveform）：​舊版​格式​

​儲存​：

  • *.TLW（TravelLogic Waveform）：​建議​格式​

​匯入​：

  • Agilent LA Module CSV
  • Tektronix TLA Data Exchange Format
  • ​通用​ LA ​文字​檔​
  • DSO ​文字​檔​
  • ​自訂​格式​檔案​

​匯出​： ​關於​ VCD、MATLAB、​二​進位​及其​他​匯出​格式​，​請​參閱​ ​匯出​資料​。

docs.title: 整理​檔案
docs.text:
• ​使用​含​日期​的​描述性​檔名​（​例如​ i2c_sensor_2026-03-10.tlw）
  • ​儲存​參考​波形​以便​比​對​
  • ​使用​ .TLW ​格式​保留​解碼​設定​與​波形​

docs.title: 從​其他​分析​儀匯入
docs.text:
• ​確認​取樣​率​與​時基​相容性​
  • ​匯入​前驗證​通道​對應​
  • ​先​以​小型​檔案​測試​以​確認​格式​
  • ​匯入​ CSV ​時必須​連接​硬體​裝置​

docs.title: 檔案​相容性
docs.text:
• .TLW ​檔案​保留​所有​設定​與​解碼​配置​
  • ​使用​「​全部​儲存​」​可​快速​備份​多個​開啟​視窗​
  • ​可開​啟舊​版​ .LAW ​檔案​，​但​建議​另存​為​ .TLW

docs.title: 相關​主題
docs.text:
• ​匯出​資料​：​將​波形​與​報告​匯出​為​多種​格式​
  • ​偏好​設定​：​設定​工作​目錄​與​自動​儲存行​為​
  • ​瀏覽​波形​資料​：​儲存​與​還原​通道​標​籤​配置​

docs.title: 了解​介面
docs.text: ​了解​邏輯​分析​儀​介面​配置​，​以及​各​元件​如何​協同​運作​以​完成​訊號​擷取​與​分析​。 ​無論​您​是否​擁有​ Acute ​邏輯​分析​儀產品​，​都​可以​依本​指南​操作​。​若​您​尚未​擁有​裝置​，​可​在​軟體​中​以示​演​模式​（Demo Mode）​執行​。

docs.title: 主視窗​概覽
docs.text:
​邏輯​分析​儀​介面​分為​數個​區域​，​各自​在​擷取​與​分析​流程​中​扮演​特定​角色​。

​邏輯​分析​儀​模式​的​使用者​介面

docs.title: 1. ​工具​列
docs.text:
​工具​列位​於​視窗​頂部​，​提供​擷取​設定​與​控制​的​快速​存取​。

​主要​功能​

  • ​快速​設定​（Quick Settings）：​快速​且​便利​的​協定​設定​預設​。

  • ​擷取​設定​（Capture Settings）：​設定​擷取​模式​、​取樣​率​、​記憶體​深度​、​臨界值​等​。

    • ​取樣​率​：​設定​時序​模式​的​內部​時脈​頻率​
    • ​臨界值​：​設定​邏輯​偵測​的​電壓​位準​
    • ​記憶體​深度​：​設定​擷取​記憶體​使用量​
    • ​觸發​設定​：​設定觸​發類​型​與​條件​

  • ​開始​（Start）​與​停止​（Stop）​按鈕​：​開始​或​結束​擷取​流程​。

​在​擷取​任何​資料​之前​，​請務必​先檢查​擷取​設定​（Capture Settings）。​選擇​所​需​的​擷取​模式​、​取樣​率​、​擷取​時間​、​連接​埠​、​電壓​，​以及​其他​與​您​量測​需求​相關​的​設定​。​這些​選項​取決​於​您​正在​量測​的​對象​。

Note

​介面​可能​因邏輯​分析​儀型號​而​略有不同​。​上圖​截圖​來​自​ TravelLogic ​應用​程式​。

​若要​進​一步​了解​擷取​設定​的​配置​，​請​參閱​本​使用​手冊​的​ ​擷取​設定​（Capture Settings） ​章節​。

docs.title: 2. ​通道​標​籤
docs.text:
​通道​標​籤​區域​顯示​已​設定​的​通道​、​匯流排​與​協定​解碼器​，​用​於​標示訊號​以便​識別​。​此區域​位​於​波形​區左側​。​您​可​在​此​新增​、​刪除​、​設定​或​重新排列​通道​順序​。

​若要​進​一步​了解​通道​標​籤​的​配置​，​請​參閱​本​使用​手冊​的​ ​通道​標​籤​（Channel Labels） ​章節​。

docs.title: 3. ​波形​區
docs.text:
​完成​資料​擷取​後​，​波形​區即​為​顯示​擷取​資料​的​位置​。​您​可​使用​滑鼠​滾輪​放大​或縮​小​波形​。​在​檢視區​內​按住​並​拖曳​可​左右​平移​。

​波形​區顯示​內容​

  • ​數位​訊號​轉換​（0/1 ​邏輯​位準​）
  • ​底部​時間​刻度​
  • ​觸發點​標記​（​通常​位​於​中央​或​使用者​定義​位置​）
  • ​用​於​量測​的​游標線​
  • ​匯流​排解​碼​註​解​（​若​已​啟用​）
  • ​註​解​與​標​記​（​若​已​新增​）

​若要​進​一步​了解​波形​區的​詳細​操作​，​請​參閱​本​使用​手冊​的​ ​瀏覽​波形​資料​（Navigate the data） ​章節​。

docs.title: 4. ​報告​視窗
docs.text:
​在​波形​區​下方​顯示​分析​結果​。

​報告​類型​：

  1. ​通道​狀態​（Channel Status）

    • ​顯示​邏輯​位準​轉換​
    • ​狀態​變​更​的​時間​戳記​
    • ​數值​歷史​紀錄​

  2. ​匯流​排解​碼結果​（Bus Decode Results）

    • ​協定​層級​交易​
    • ​位址​、​資料​與​控制​資訊​
    • ​錯誤​偵測​與​旗標​
    • ​可自訂​欄位​

  3. ​波形​量測​統計​（Waveform Measurement Statistics）

    • ​週期​與​頻率​量測​
    • ​脈衝​寬度​分析​
    • ​通道​間​延遲​
    • ​邊緣​計數​

​報告​工具​列​功能​：

  • ​切換​報告​類型​
  • ​匯出​為​ CSV/TXT
  • ​設定​欄位​
  • ​儲存​報告​設定​

​若要​進​一步​了解​報告區​的​詳細​功能​，​請​參閱​本​使用​手冊​的​ ​瀏覽​報告​（Navigate the report） ​章節​。

docs.title: 5. ​狀態​列
docs.text:
​顯示​裝置​連線​與​擷取​狀態​資訊​。

​位置​： ​視窗​底部​

​顯示​資訊​：

  • ​裝置​連線​狀態​（​已連線​/​已中斷​連線​）
  • ​裝置​型號​與​序號​
  • ​擷取​狀態​（​閒置​/​執行​中​/​已​停止​）
  • ​目前​取樣​率​
  • ​記憶體​使用量​

​指示​燈​：

  • ​綠色​：​裝置​已​連線且​就緒​
  • ​紅色​：​裝置​已​中斷​連線​或​發生​錯誤​
  • ​黃​色​：​擷取​進行​中​

docs.title: 各​元件​如何​協同​運作
docs.text:
​工具​列​ ↔ ​波形​區​：

  • ​工具​列設定​決定​擷取​與​顯示​的​內容​
  • ​波形​縮​放影​響可見​細節​，​但​不​改變​擷取​設定​

​通道​標​籤​ ↔ ​波形​區​：

  • ​標​籤​控制​顯示​哪些​訊號​
  • ​重新排列​標​籤​會​改變​波形​顯示​順序​
  • ​標​籤​設​定影​響解碼​與​顯示​

​波形​區​ ↔ ​報告​視窗​：

  • ​波形​中​的​游標​可​限制​報告​範圍​
  • ​點選​報告​列會​反白​對應​的​波形​位置​
  • ​解碼​設定​同時​影響​波形​註​解​與​報​告​內​容​

docs.title: 接下​來​？
docs.text:
• ​快速​開始​（Quick Start）：​工作​流程​入門​指南​
  • ​擷取​設定​（Capture Settings）：​設定​工具​列參數​

  • ​導覽​：

    • ​瀏覽​波形​資料​（Navigate the data）：​波形​操作​詳解​
    • ​瀏覽​報告​（Navigate the report）：​了解​報告​顯示​

docs.title: 鍵盤​快捷​鍵
docs.text: ​邏輯​分析​儀​操作​的​快速​鍵盤​快捷​鍵​。

docs.title: 可用​快捷​鍵
docs.text: 功能​ ​按鍵​ ​移至​游標​位置​ A-Z ​在​滑鼠​位置​新增​游標​ Shift + A-Z ​開始​擷取​ Enter ​停止​擷取​ ESC ​搜尋​ F3 ​或​ Ctrl+F ​波形​區​放大​ ​數字鍵​盤​ + ​波形​區縮​小​ ​數字鍵​盤​ -

docs.title: 瀏覽​波形​資料
docs.text: ​瀏覽​資料​時​有​一些​實用​技巧​。​以下​是​最​常用​的​方法​。

docs.title: 縮放​ / ​平移
docs.text:
​左右​平移​

​在​波形​區​按住​滑鼠​左鍵並​拖曳​至​左​或​右​。

​放大​與​縮​小​

​滑鼠​滾輪​向上​或​按​ ​數字鍵​盤​ + ​可​放大​。 ​滑鼠​滾輪​向下​或​按​ ​數字鍵​盤​ - ​可縮​小​。

docs.title: 快速​計算
docs.text:
​按住​滑鼠​右鍵並​拖曳​以選取​區間​。​您​可以​取得​：

  • ​所選區​間​內​的​訊號​轉換​次數​
  • ​時間​長​度​（​持續​時間​）
  • ​平均​頻率​

​例如​，​如下​圖​所示​，​我們​可以​立即​估算​ I2C Clock ​頻率​約​為​ 95 kHz。

​快速​計算

docs.title: 快速​註​解​與​標​記
docs.text:
​直接​在​波形​區​新增​註​解​與​視​覺​標​記​，​以記錄​重要​的​訊號​或​條件​。

​快速​註​解​與​標​記​

​這讓​您​可以​在​特定​時間​位置​快速​新增​文字​標​籤​、​圖形​標記​與​註​解​，​更​方便​在​波形​區的​任何​位置​記錄​您​的​發現​。

docs.title: 垂直​調整
docs.text:
​您​可以​拖曳​標​籤​邊界來​調整​通道​標​籤​。

​調整​通道​標​籤​高度​

​也​可以​調整​通道​標​籤​的​順序​。

​調整​通道​標​籤​順序​

​若要​進​一步​了解​如何​管理​通道​標​籤​，​另​請​參閱​ ​通道​標​籤​ ​章節​。

docs.title: 顯示​最佳化
docs.text:
​按​一下​向上​箭頭​圖示​可​隱藏​工具​列​。

​若​要​最大化​波形​區​，​可將​波形​區與報​告區​之間​的​分隔​線​拖曳​至​底部​。

docs.title: 透過​游標​快速​導覽
docs.text:
​您​可以​使用​游標​快速​跳至​波形​區的​特定​位置​。

​請​看​以下​範例​。​假設​ Cursor H ​位​於​目前​的​檢視​範圍​之外​，​我們​想要​快速​跳​至​該​位置​。

​按下​ H ​鍵​即可​跳至​ Cursor H，​游標​ H ​現在會​出現​在​波形​區​中央​。

​它們​就​像​書​籤​一樣​。​下次​您​可以​在​任何​想要​快速​參考​的​位置​放置​游標​，​這​有助​於​快速​且​有效率​地​瀏覽​波形​區​。​按​ Shift + A-Z ​鍵​即可​新增​游標​。

​另​請​參閱​ ​游標​操作​ ​以​了解​更多​詳情​。

docs.title: 概覽
docs.text:
​報告區​是​檢視​擷取​資料​分析​結果​的​地方​。 ​您​大多​會​使用​報告區​來​檢視​協定​解碼​結果​。

​此處​可檢視​數種​報告​：

  • Protocol decoder result（​依​不同​協定​而​異​）

  • Transition report（0、1 ​邏輯​位準​與​時間​戳記​）

  • Waveform statistics（​週期​、​頻率​、​邊緣​計數​等​）

docs.title: Report Toolbar
docs.text:
：​切換​至​ Transition ​報告​

：​切換​至​ Protocol decoder ​報告​

：​切換​至​ Waveform statistics ​報告​

：​將報​告資料​匯出​為​ TXT/CSV ​格式​

：​重新整理​分析​結果​，​用​於​協定​解碼器​與​波形​統計​報告​
